en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a rather dilapidated three‑storey masonry townhouse with classical details. The building has large rectangular windows, some with shutters or broken panes, and a central entrance with a small pedimented porch. The plastered facade shows heavy wear and peeling, suggesting age or war damage. Dormer windows are visible in the mansard roof. At street level on the right is a lower annex or shopfront with open doors and shutters. No sky or landscape is emphasized; the view tightly frames the facade along a slightly sloping street. The overall style is late‑19th‑century Central or Eastern European urban architecture.
